rule: Sessions in date order. The last 3 sessions are test sessions: in each, the first third of the non-excluded trials (index order) -> cal, the rest -> test. Earlier sessions: the last 10 % of the trials (at least 1) -> val, the rest -> train. Local id = <session>|<index>. Payload = truth text | number of bins from go cue to sentence end.

units.trial: one non-excluded sentence trial of Datasets/<session>/sentences.mat
